note: Written by scripts/capture.mjs. Emulator recordings of the real app.

unlock.what: The Unlock screen: 'Buy it once. Keep it forever.' and the four promises. Its price button spins, because the product is in no Play Console yet, so the hook that uses this stops above it.

style.what: The style sheet: eighteen presets animating the user's own line, four of them tapped, the scroll past the first six, then the colour pair, the size and the position frame

dictionary.what: The word 'brand' → 'Add to your words' → the dictionary with the entry half written → Save, back in the editor

saving.what: Export → Save to gallery → the progress bar → Saved, with the tick, the filename and Share. One recording rather than two, because a separate Saved shot would have to be timed against the export by hand.

pick.what: Airplane mode on. Home → New video → the system picker → the curtain → Processing with the words arriving → the editor. Run last: it makes a second project, and it needs the gallery cleared of exports first.

toggle.what: The quick-settings shade pulled down over Home and the Airplane mode tile tapped. The physical action, on camera.

saved.what: The Saved screen: the tick, the filename, Share, and the one-time feedback card. No setup on purpose — it records whatever is on screen, and it is meant to be run right after the `saving` shot's export has actually finished, which on this emulator is 54 s, longer than that shot records.

home.what: Home standing still: the promise line, New video, the watermark chip, and the one project

editor.what: The editor playing: the Focus card on the stage, the blue mark travelling word by word, the transcript scrolling under it

fix.what: The '1 to check' chip opens the one dotted word, 'Don't.' — 'Not sure about this one' — and Looks right clears it and the chip with it

timing.what: The timing sheet on that same word: its window on the waveform, the end handle dragged out, then Move +50 twice

export.what: A real Wordburn export. Captions burned in by the app's own module, not redrawn here.
